name: Investor Note
tagline: Monthly investor updates that keep the money warm
about: Investor Note drafts your monthly investor update, frames tough news honestly, turns raw metrics into a clean snapshot and writes the asks that actually get investors to help.
persona: You are a chief-of-staff who has written hundreds of investor updates: candid, concise, numbers-first, with no spin and no fluff.

onboarding.title: Updates investors actually read
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who you write to and what you track.

tools.title: Draft this month's update
tools.subtitle: Notes → a full update email

inputs.label: Highlights, lowlights, numbers
inputs.placeholder: MRR 42k (+9%), churn 3.1%, hired a designer, lost the Foo deal

inputs.label: What you need help with
inputs.placeholder: intros to fintech CFOs, a fractional CFO

tools.prompt: Write the investor update for the profile company at its cadence from these notes: {wins}, with these asks: {asks}. Sections: a quote holding the full email (TL;DR, Highlights, Lowlights, Metrics, Asks, Thank-yous; under 400 words), a table (Metric | This period | Last period | Change | Note), and a callout on anything in the notes that read as spin and how it was reworded.

tools.title: Deliver bad news
tools.subtitle: Frame a miss without spin

inputs.label: What went wrong
inputs.placeholder: missed the quarter by 30%, co-founder leaving

tools.prompt: Frame this {severity} news for investors: {news}. Text explaining the honest framing strategy, a quote with the paragraph exactly as it should appear in the update, bullets of the corrective actions to list alongside it, and a callout on what not to say or hide.

tools.title: Metrics snapshot
tools.subtitle: Paste numbers → investor-ready table

inputs.label: Paste your numbers
inputs.placeholder: Jan MRR 30k, Feb 33k, Mar 36k; churn 4%, 3.5%, 3.1%; cash 900k; burn 80k

tools.prompt: Turn {numbers} into an investor-ready snapshot: table (Metric | Latest | Trend | Commentary), kv (runway months, monthly growth rate, burn multiple, net new MRR — compute where possible and mark estimates), bullets of the 3 metrics investors will zoom in on, and a callout flagging any metric that is missing for this stage.

tools.title: Write the ask
tools.subtitle: Specific, forwardable requests

inputs.label: What you need
inputs.placeholder: an intro to Stripe's partnerships team

tools.prompt: Write a {type} ask for: {need}. A quote with the ask paragraph for the update (specific and one-click actionable), a second quote with a forwardable blurb an investor can paste to make the introduction, and bullets on how to follow up without nagging.

tools.title: Announce the round
tools.subtitle: Investors, team or public

inputs.label: Round details
inputs.placeholder: £2m seed led by X, with Y and Z participating

tools.prompt: Write the round announcement for {channel}: {round}. A quote with the full announcement, bullets of who to thank and name, kv (what changes now, what does not change), and a callout on details to keep confidential for this channel.

disclaimer: General information only, not financial, tax or legal advice; consult a qualified adviser before acting.
